keywords: Vitalik 呼吁软硬件附“信任营养标签”
EIP-2780 预编译目标与账户预热收费
EIP-8250 keyed nonce 改进讨论
summary: Vitalik 提出理想情况下所有软硬件都应附“营养标签”，列出系统依赖的数学和哪些参与方的诚实行为。rakita 提交 EIP-2780 修改，把预编译作为交易目标时也按普通账户计量。Magicians 上有人结合 EVVM 的异步 nonce 经验提议改进 EIP-8250。parithosh 讨论替换并退役 Sepolia 测试网。

keywords_en: Vitalik calls for trust "nutrition labels" on software and hardware
EIP-2780 precompile target and account warming charges
summary_en: Vitalik suggested that ideally all software and hardware would carry "nutrition labels" listing the math and the actors' honest behavior a system relies on. rakita submitted an EIP-2780 change that meters precompiles as transaction targets like any other account. A Magicians thread drew on EVVM's async nonce experience to propose improvements to EIP-8250. parithosh discussed replacing and sunsetting the Sepolia testnet.
